tools.name: about
tools.description: What DTA (dta.mn) is: Mongolia's signed, source-bound macro/market data archive — coverage, corpus size, how to verify.

tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Search the series catalog by code or name (English or Mongolian). Returns up to 15 series with codes to use in get_panel.

tools.name: get_panel
tools.description: Time series (latest vintage per date) for up to 8 series codes. Each point is [date, value, shortid]; the shortid is the signed-passport handle for get_datum.

tools.name: get_datum
tools.description: One signed observation's passport by shortid: value, vintage, source URL, schema, Ed25519 signature + the canonical payload recipe to verify it.

tools.name: get_movers
tools.description: Today's biggest movers across the archive — the signed movers:v0 snapshot (ranked by delta z-score).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: The catalogue's topics: code, names, shape and how many series each holds. Start here, then get_topic.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: One topic's concepts and their series, each series with its latest value. Topic codes come from list_topics: inflation, fx, money, rates, mm_rates, growth, fiscal, external, equities, housing, air, commodities, livestock, food, coal, retail, transport, macro and more.

tools.name: get_family
tools.description: Every series whose code matches an SQL LIKE pattern (% any run, _ one character), each with its latest value, 400 at most. Families: mn.cpi.%.yoy.monthly (the CPI divisions), bank.%.fx.usd.ref (each bank's USD rate), mn.khural.member.%.attendance.pct.monthly (each member of parliament), mn.gov.gover

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: One series' facts: names in English and Mongolian, unit, granularity, vendor, description, first and last date, number of points, latest value, and its page.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: A signed board: khural (the State Great Khural member by member: attendance, votes cast, votes with the party, questions; summarised), auctions (open land auctions, lot by lot), auction_results (the last 30 days' land auction results), rail (today's train departures from Ulaanbaatar), fuel_stations

tools.name: get_bulk
tools.description: The signed bulk release: the whole record as gzipped CSV (every value, every vintage, the catalogue), each file's sha256 and size; download at https://dta.mn/bulk/<name>.
